description: Kutaisi-shop-transit's GZCoord integration (kutaisi-shop-transit): a session in its working copy is on the fleet's coordination channel — the same relay and channel as every other project of the fleet, hosted on the coordinator's workspace. Read by gzcoord-inbox when the working copy resolves to project kutaisi-shop-transit; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. No token_env_file: the account's token is read from its own secrets.env (ADR-038 rule 9). relay_runtime_dir is relative to the workspace, never inside a repository. Written 2026-10-21 (j332): the project was registered without one, and the inbox watch exited 3 in its working copy (devex-tooling, 01a15cd0).
